concerns.text: The processed dataset `data/processed/clean_alloy_data.parquet` is required (by `contracts/mg_dataset.schema.yaml` and the `AlloyEntry` entity in `data-model.md`) to contain a `checksum` field for each row. The plan never mentions generating or storing per‑row SHA‑256 checksums, only that raw API responses are saved with a global `checksums.txt`. This omission means the artifact will fail schema validation and violates Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) which mandates checksummed data at the row level.
